name: Doctor Boat Control Marine Intelligence V7.0
release_notes: First-vector-chart milestone: S-57 layers are extracted with Python GDAL and rendered inside DR Boat.
Chart Manager can load a selected S-57/GeoJSON chart by button or double click.
Map pan, zoom and Fit Chart are active.
Built-in demo vector chart verifies the renderer without external chart files; demo is not for navigation.
CM93 is still detected but not misrepresented as decoded.
